decision_candidates.text: Decision: lane file is `kimi_lane.rs`, not `kimi.rs`** — the W0 contract (`docs/DISTILL_CONTRACT.md` rule 4: `src/extraction/distill/<agent>_lane.rs`) is frozen and wins over the brief's loose naming.

Decision: gates come only from the `Bash` tool** (kimi's sole shell-shaped tool), matched against a gate-command vocabulary (`cargo test/clippy/fmt/build/check`, `npm test`, `make test/check`); verdict is read from the correlated `tool.result` body via explicit pass/fail markers, else `Unknown` — never guessed.
Decision: `agent_outcome` stays `Unknown` in v1**; the only upgrade-with-evidence is `ending: "interrupted"` when the substrate reports a malformed tail.
